title: Two-Shaft Plain Weave Shed Transition & Selvage Control
summary: Coordinate foot treadles for warp shed alternation, shuttle transit, and uniform reed beat-up tension.

claims.statement: Step 1: Depress treadle #1 fully to separate odd and even warp threads into a clean 45mm open shed before throwing shuttle.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Depress treadle #1 fully to separate odd and even warp threads into a clean 45mm open shed before throwing shuttle.

claims.statement: Step 2: The reed must beat the newly laid weft pick into the cloth fell only after the treadles alternate to lock the thread in place.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: The reed must beat the newly laid weft pick into the cloth fell only after the treadles alternate to lock the thread in place.
